g).text:
These are a bunch of costumes that you can use while following my Geometry Dash tutorial on YouTube:

https://youtu.be/FYZ1bfB1nho

These are based off the original sprites from Geometry Dash by RobTop Games

g*.text:
These tiles are a little smaller than the ones I use in the video, if you need to scale them up, then you can do! :)
Otherwise you may need to tweak your jump to get the timing right (as always)
